subject: general
question: As per performance of the Indian states, which of the following states was in the 'Front Runner' category in the NITI Aayog SDG India Index 2020 - 21?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tripura**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **According to the NITI Aayog SDG India Index 2020-2**1, **Tripura was classified under the 'Front Runner' category** for its performance on achieving the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
 
• The **NITI Aayog SDG India Index** tracks the progress of states and union territories in achieving the **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)** set by the United Nations.
 
• The 2020-21 edition ranked the states in four categories:
 
• **Front Runner**: States that have performed well and are on track to achieve the SDGs.
 
• **Achiever**: States that have made significant progress but still need to make improvements in some areas.
 
• **Performer**: States that are showing progress but need further efforts to meet SDG targets.
 
• **Aspirant**: States that are lagging behind in achieving SDG targets.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Uttarakhand, Gujarat, Maharashtra, Mizoram, Punjab, Haryana, Tripura, Delhi, Lakshadweep, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh graduated to the category of Front-Runners (scores between 65 and 99, including both).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd79408ee0073ee1e7210d42c9ecde4fa2603fdc8bb955fc42f58ee2f49b13ba.png]
